div.div: Solid line = a request or data flow. Orange = a call into the engine, by a rule's name. Dashed grey line = a hand-off outside the request path (the promoted model). Dashed border = runs in-process, or not built yet. Services: gateway, planner, db, mailpit; ml, retrain, pipeline-processing, pipeline-training, web-build, jaeger and dev-services start only on request (their profiles).

pipeline-processing, pipeline-training, web-build, jaeger and dev-services start only on request (their profiles).
